listenings.text: Good morning, everybody, and welcome to the first round. My name is Marcus Reed, and I work at a university in the United States. I am a researcher, and I also teach. I work with public schools, and my project is about technology in small towns. We usually meet every two weeks, and I always prepare before the call. This year I want to learn from the other groups. I would like to visit Brazil in November. Thank you, and it is very good to be here.

Hi, this is a short message before your first round. Here is a small idea to help you. Do not try to say everything. Four sentences are enough: who you are, what you do, one number about your work, and one thing you want this year. Say the four sentences slowly. If you speak slowly, everybody understands you, and nobody looks at the clock. See you at the meeting, and good luck.

extra_audio.text: Joice opens the call and waits for her turn. She says her name and where she works. She says what she does and one number about her work. She says what she wants to learn this year. Everybody says thank you and the next person speaks.
